IncludeTests.description: When true, an xUnit test project with HTTP smoke tests is generated. When false, the tests/ tree is omitted.

EnableIdentity.description: When true, the generated host enables the platform identity lifecycle capability with missing-provider fallbacks. Application-owned stores stay application-owned.

EnablePersistence.description: When true, the generated host references Platform.Persistence.EfCore plus an application-owned SQLite provider, ships an application-owned AppDbContext, and registers the platform audit/soft-delete interceptor. Providers, migrations, and seed data stay application-owned.

EnableSiteUsers.description: When true, the generated host adds application-owned ASP.NET Core Identity users, cookie authentication, login/logout/recovery Razor pages, a deny-by-default permission catalog, an opt-in self-registration toggle, and a Development-only bootstrap-owner command. When false, no Identity dependencies, routes, or schema are emitted. Independent of EnableIdentity (lifecycle) and EnableAdmin (manager capability).
